title: Find the Mistakes: Fake Microsoft Email
subject: URGENT: Your Microsoft Account Will Be Suspended
scenario:
Dear Employee,

We detected unusual activity on your Microsoft 365 account. Your account will be permanently suspended in 15 minutes unless you verify your details.

Click here to secure your account:
https://microsoft.com/security

Actual destination: https://micros0ft-login.example/verify

Please enter your password and MFA code. Do not contact IT during this process.

Regards,
Microsoft Security Team
email_note: TASK: Inspect the sender, domain, link and message. Identify the suspicious elements.
explanation: The sender uses a zero instead of the letter o in micros0ft. The destination is an unrelated domain, the message creates urgency, requests passwords and MFA codes, and discourages contacting IT.
evidence_caption: Find the suspicious mistakes in this email.

title: Find the Mistakes: Fake Company Domain
subject: Important: Salary Revision Confirmation
scenario:
Dear Employee,

Your revised salary details are ready. All employees must confirm their salary information today.

Open the employee portal:
https://fujisilvertech.com

Actual destination: https://fujisilvertech-careers.example/salary

Reply-To: salary-confirm@external-mail.example

Please download the attached salary form and enter your employee ID, password and bank details.

Failure to respond may delay your salary revision.
email_note: TASK: Examine the email carefully. Find every suspicious domain, address and request.
explanation: The sender domain is not the official company domain, the displayed link differs from the actual destination, the Reply-To address is external, and the attachment requests sensitive credentials and bank information.
evidence_caption: Find the suspicious mistakes in this HR email.

title: Find the Mistakes: Fake Invoice
subject: Immediate Payment Required – Outstanding Invoice
scenario:
Hello Finance Team,

Our supplier has reported an overdue invoice. Please process the payment immediately using the attached document.

Invoice: INV-2026-1182

Beneficiary: North Star Supplies

New Bank Account: 1234567890

Please do not follow the usual approval process because management has already approved this payment.

Reply to confirm once the transaction is complete.

Regards,
Accounts Department
email_note: TASK: Inspect this payment request. Identify the warning signs that could indicate invoice fraud or impersonation.
explanation: The request introduces new bank details, pressures the recipient to pay immediately and asks them to bypass normal approval controls. Verify the supplier and payment independently before processing.

title: Find the Mistakes: Fake IT Support Email
subject: MFA Reset Required – Action Needed
scenario:
Dear User,

Your MFA configuration has expired. To prevent interruption to your account, download the attached file named MFA_Update.exe.

Alternatively, scan the QR code in the attachment and sign in to restore your access.

Our support team may contact you and ask you to approve an authentication notification.

Complete this process within 10 minutes.

Regards,
IT Helpdesk
email_note: TASK: Investigate the sender, attachment, QR code and authentication instructions. Identify the suspicious details.
explanation: The sender uses an unverified domain, the executable attachment is suspicious, the QR code could lead to a fake login page, the message creates urgency and encourages unexpected MFA approval.
evidence_caption: Find the suspicious elements in this IT support message.
